Hologram Accuracy.desc: Projectile error of the holograms (lower = more accurate).

Hologram Target Tracking & Leading.desc: How well the holograms track and lead moving targets.

Beam.desc: His eliminator beam's fire rate and shots per burst.

Beam Projectile.desc: Beam range and velocity (shared with the sentinel eliminators).

Beam Damage.desc: Beam damage (shared with the sentinel eliminators).

Needler.desc: His needler's fire rate and shots per burst.

Needler Projectile.desc: Needle range and velocity (shared with the sentinels).

Needler Damage.desc: Needle impact damage (shared with the sentinels).

Rocket.desc: His rocket's fire rate and shots per burst.

Enforcer Chassis.desc: His hull's movement — top speed, acceleration and turning.

Melee Behavior.desc: Delay/timeout between hammer swings and the chance of one.

Melee Leap.desc: His hammer lunge range, velocity, chance and arc.

Gravity Hammer Damage.desc: Damage of the gravity hammer — its swing, ground-slam explosion and obstacle smash.

Gravity Hammer Radius.desc: Blast radius of the hammer's swing and ground-slam.

Body Vitality.desc: Guilty Spark's health during the boss fight (stock: 2000).

Beam Damage.desc: Damage of his eye beam (stock: 100 per hit).

Beam Rate of Fire.desc: How fast his eye beam ticks (stock: 30 rounds per second).
